title: Radioiodine-induced oxidative stress in patients with differentiated thyroid carcinoma and effect of supplementation with vitamins C and E and selenium (antioxidants)
authors: Pedro Weslley Rosário, Kelly Cristina Siqueira Batista, Maria Regina Calsolari
abstract: Radioiodine therapy for thyroid cancer was studied for its oxidative stress effects. Antioxidant supplementation significantly reduced this stress.
